answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the nebula bond on all of them and exposing each to the falcon slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 12 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the horizon audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm of 62 pays that 208 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
